Class Fleet

java.lang.Object
fleet.Fleet
public class Fleet extends Object
This class creates a dynamic array of Vehicle objects that allows to add, remove, find, and a print sorted by make (then obtained date).
Author:
Carly Chick

  • Method Details

    • find

      private int find(Vehicle vehicle)
      Finds the index of a vehicle in the fleet array.
      Parameters:
      vehicle - the vehicle to look for
      Returns:
      the index of the vehicle if found; -1 if not found

    • grow

      private void grow()
      Increases the size of the fleet array by 4.

    • add

      public void add(Vehicle vehicle)
      Adds a vehicle to the fleet if it is not null and not already present. Grows the array if there is no room.
      Parameters:
      vehicle - the vehicle to add

    • remove

      public void remove(Vehicle vehicle)
      Removes a vehicle from the fleet if it exists. The last vehicle in the array is moved into the removed spot.
      Parameters:
      vehicle - the vehicle to remove

    • contains

      public boolean contains(Vehicle vehicle)
      Checks whether a given vehicle is already in the fleet.
      Parameters:
      vehicle - vehicle to check
      Returns:
      true if the vehicle is found; false otherwise

    • printByMake

      public void printByMake()
      Prints all vehicles in the fleet in order by make and obtained date. Sorting is done using selection sort.

    • getVehicle

      public Vehicle getVehicle(Vehicle vehicle)
      Returns the vehicle in the fleet equal to the given one.
      Parameters:
      vehicle - the vehicle to search for
      Returns:
      the stored vehicle if found; null if not found
